Announcements

Welcome to Feni University

Feni University (FU) started its academic activities in May 2013 with the approval of the Government of Bangladesh and the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Private University Act, 2010. Its mission is to provide tertiary education at a reasonable cost while upholding academic standards in subjects relevant to the needs of the nation and the world.

As the first private university in the greater Noakhali region, FU nurtures ethical values and aims to be a centre of excellence in higher education.

About Us

History, mission, vision and campus

Brief history

Feni University was established in 2012 and began academic activities in May 2013 with the approval of the Government of Bangladesh and the UGC under the Private University Act, 2010. It is the first private university in the greater Noakhali region and has grown into one of the emerging universities of Bangladesh.

Mission

To provide tertiary education at a reasonable cost while upholding the expected academic standard in subjects relevant to current and future social and economic needs of the nation and the world.

Vision

To flourish as a centre of excellence in higher education that promotes ethical standards, values and norms in society.

Campus & Leadership

  • Campus: Trunk Road, Feni-3900, with Building-A and Building-C hosting classrooms and offices.
  • Permanent campus: construction of the main building has been inaugurated.
  • Chairman, Board of Trustees: Mr. Md. Nurun Newaz Salim
  • Vice Chancellor (Acting): Dr. Masudul Hoq Chowdhury
  • Registrar: Dr. Mohammad Zahirul Hoque

Admission

Requirements, process and online inquiry

Programmes

  • Undergraduate programmes
  • Graduate programmes (MBA, EMBA, RMBA and more)
  • Post Graduate Diploma programme

General requirements

  • Required SSC/HSC (or equivalent) results as per UGC and university policy for the chosen programme.
  • Academic certificates, transcripts, passport-size photographs and national ID/birth certificate.

Exact eligibility, tuition and waivers are published by the university: undergraduate / graduate / tuition policy.

Application Process

  1. Select a department and programme.
  2. Apply on the official online admission portal.
  3. Submit documents and complete verification.
  4. Pay fees and receive your student ID.
